mapper.insert: INSERT INTO identity_verification (member_id, birth_year, gender, ci_hash, provider, verified_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{verification.memberId}, #{verification.birthYear}, #{verification.gender}, #{verification.ciHash.value}, #{verification.provider}, #{verification.verifiedAt}, #{verification.createdAt}, #{verification.updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM identity_verification WHERE member_id = #{memberId} FOR SHARE
